description: Creates an unpaid order for the given tyres and options and returns a Mollie checkoutUrl where the customer pays. Requires the customer's acceptance of the Terms (https://www.airbandenservice.com/nl/algemene-voorwaarden) and the total from get_quote; a different current total is refused. Nothing is ordered until the customer pays; an unpaid order expires after about 15 minutes. An identical repeat returns the same order.

acceptedTerms.description: Whether the customer accepted the Terms. The order is refused without it.

customer.description: The customer's own details, as they gave them.

address.description: Required for delivery and for a business order: street, house number, postcode and city in the Netherlands.

companyVatId.description: Only for a business invoice, e.g. NL123456789B01.

email.description: Receives the order confirmation and the receipt after payment.

licensePlate.description: Dutch licence plate. Required with fitting.

phone.description: Optional, for questions about the order, e.g. 06 12345678 or +31 6 12345678.

postcode.description: Dutch postcode, e.g. 2031 CV (optional when the address contains it).

delivery.description: pickup = collect at the workshop in Haarlem (free); delivery = shipped to an address in the Netherlands (fee from get_shop_info).

expectedTotalCents.description: totalCents from get_quote. A different current total is refused, so the customer never pays more than the quoted amount.

fitting.description: Optional: fitting and balancing at the workshop (pickup only), on a day from list_fitting_days.

items.description: Tyres to order: the slug from search_tyres and how many. At most 4 products and 8 tyres per order.

locale.description: Language of the payment page, the order page and the emails. Default nl.

tpms.description: With fitting only: the car has tyre pressure sensors (TPMS). Adds the sensor surcharge.

name: place_order
title: Place the order (customer pays online)
